author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this video, you'll learn how to package, build, and share your Unreal Engine games. Packaging involves multiple stages, so we'll walk through each one and explain what's happening, including some best practices you can apply to your own projects.

To learn more about how to get started with Unreal Engine, check out this playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZlv_N0_O1gZKUtYmZlIwZHt9i3X_BWGj

To read the Packaging Unreal Engine Projects documentation, see this page:
https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/packaging-your-project

To read the Get Started with Unreal Engine documentation, check out this page:
https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/get-started
title: Packaging Unreal Engine Projects
